parts: Production cutout sheet for ALVANEVE, small WHITE ICE DRAGON living-kite from ref1, same restrained handmade paper finish as Carcara ref2. ROW3 col1 near hind short leg root upper-right, col2 far hind leg, col3 whole curled ribbon tail root upper-right. ROW4 col1 fierce head, col2 hurt head closed squeezed eyes, col3 happy head closed relaxed eyes. Expression heads EXACT same silhouette horns muzzle nose ears dimensions and orientation as neutral, change ONLY eyes/brows. All roots solid closed overlapping tabs, NO hollow socket holes.
